heading: Rooted in Service, Ready to Lead
text: Dr. Kedner Maxime’s journey is the story of the American Dream built entirely on faith, resilience, and hard work. Arriving in the United States from Haiti in April 1981 as an 18-year-old student, he spoke little English and started with nothing. He washed dishes in local restaurants for $2.50 an hour and mowed grass on hot Florida golf courses for $4.50 an hour, working up to three jobs at a time to provide for his family. He has never forgotten the struggle of living paycheck-to-paycheck, and that is why he is stepping up to fight for you.

heading: Rooted in Service, Ready to Lead
text: For over thirty years, Dr. Maxime has stood in the trenches with Florida’s 20th District. As the founder of Advantage Tax Firm Consulting Services (since 1996), he has sat across kitchen tables from thousands of local taxpayers—helping them navigate tax codes, start businesses, and achieve the dream of U.S. citizenship. As a pastor for 16 years at L’Eglise la Voix du Salut and a trusted WLQY 1320AM radio host for two decades, his leadership has always been driven by a simple, unyielding creed: Service over Politics, Solutions over Promises.

heading: Affordability & Lower Inflation
text: Families are being squeezed by housing, groceries, insurance, and healthcare. Dr. Maxime will fight to bring costs down and open real pathways to ownership and long-term wealth.

heading: Secure borders, fair laws, and a path forward.
text: Drawing on 30 years working with immigrant families, Dr. Maxime believes we can have both security and compassion — borders that protect our communities.

heading: Healthcare is a right, not a luxury.
text: Seniors rationing insulin. Parents skipping their own care. Families going bankrupt from a single hospital bill. Dr. Maxime will fight to lower drug costs.

heading: Where you live matters. Education for all.
text: Our schools are underfunded and our teachers underpaid. Dr. Maxime will fight to raise funding and pay, and build real pathways to careers site-wide.

heading: Immigration
text: Dr. Kedner Maxime's balanced plan — secure borders, fair laws, a legal path for those who follow the law, and family reunification.

heading: On the Issues
text: A different kind of voice on immigration

heading: On the Issues
text: For more than 30 years, Dr. Maxime has worked with immigrant families across South Florida — as an accountant, a U.S. citizenship service consultant, and a pastor. He has sat across the table from families navigating a complex system, helped them understand their rights, and helped them become proud American citizens. He knows this issue not from a talking point, but from a lifetime of walking with people through it.

heading: On the Issues
text: The system isn't working for anyone. It isn't working for families waiting years for a decision. It isn't working for communities dealing with the consequences of chaos at the border. And it isn't working for the people who want to do things the right way and can't find one.

heading: Solutions
text: Dr. Maxime believes we can have both security and compassion — and that we should stop pretending we have to choose:
Secure borders that protect our communities.
A pathway to citizenship for those who contribute to our society.
Family-reunification policies that keep families together.
A clear, fair pathway to legal permanent residency for those who follow the law.
Fair, faster processing so people who follow the rules aren't punished for doing so.
"We are a nation of laws and a nation of compassion."

heading: Healthcare
text: Dr. Kedner Maxime's plan to lower prescription drug costs, protect pre-existing conditions, expand access, and strengthen community health centers.

heading: On the Issues
text: As a pastor for 16 years, Dr. Maxime has stood with families in their greatest joys and their deepest struggles. He has met seniors rationing insulin because they can't afford a full dose. He has met working parents who skip their own doctor visits so their children can be seen. He has met families driven into bankruptcy by a single medical emergency. In the richest nation on earth, that is not acceptable.

heading: Solutions
text: Dr. Maxime will bring that ground-level view to Washington and fight for a healthcare system that actually serves the people paying for it:
Lower prescription drug costs so no senior has to choose between insulin and groceries.
Protect coverage for people with pre-existing conditions — no one should lose care because of a diagnosis outside their control.
Expand access to affordable care for working families, the self-employed, and small-business owners.
Strengthen the community health centers that serve our most vulnerable neighbors — the safety net working families rely on.
Bring transparency to hospital and insurance billing so families aren't blindsided by charges they never agreed to.
Healthcare is not a luxury. It's a right. And in Congress, Dr. Maxime will fight for that right — for every family in District 20.

heading: Education
text: Dr. Maxime plans to work to raise school funding and teacher pay, expand vocational training, and build real career pathways for District 20's young people.

heading: On the Issues
text: Dr. Maxime spent 25 years teaching Sunday school in Broward County churches. He knows the difference a great teacher makes in a child's life — and he knows what it costs a community when our schools are underfunded and our teachers underpaid. In District 20, too many young people, especially in underserved communities, aren't getting the education and training they need to build the future they deserve.

heading: Solutions
text: Every child deserves a real shot — not one that depends on their zip code. Dr. Maxime will fight to:
Raise public-school funding so classrooms have the resources, materials, and support they need.
Expand vocational and technical training so students who don't take a four-year path still have a real path.
Raise teacher salaries so we can recruit and keep the great educators our children deserve.
Build real pathways — apprenticeships, dual enrollment, industry partnerships — so a diploma opens doors, not just closes a chapter.
Empower both our young men and young women with the skills, mentorship, and opportunities to succeed.
Our young people are our future. They deserve an investment in that future — regardless of zip code.

heading: On the Issues
text: Too many District 20 workers are stuck in jobs that don't pay enough to live on. Too many workers who want more can't afford the training to get there. And too many young people watch good jobs go somewhere else because the pipeline between our schools and our employers isn't connected. Economic security isn't a slogan — it's whether you can pay rent, save for retirement, and take a day off when you're sick.

heading: Solutions
text: Dr. Maxime will fight for the jobs, training, and protections District 20 workers deserve:
Invest in workforce training aligned to South Florida's real industries — healthcare, construction, logistics, hospitality, and skilled trades.
Expand apprenticeship pathways so workers can earn while they learn.
Support fair wages that keep pace with the actual cost of living in South Florida.
Defend earned benefits — Social Security, Medicare, and workplace protections — from cuts.
Protect the right to organize and negotiate for fair pay and safe conditions.
District 20 workers deserve dignity, security, and a real shot at a better life — not just a check that never quite covers the bills.
